semantics.daily: Sparse EOD snapshots emitted while open and a zero-closing row at closure. No rows before order known date. LastNonEmpty must be resolved per order line/job, not across products or whole groups.
semantics.material_trace: OBSERVED_JOB_EXECUTION only. Source events explicitly link component issue to JOB and EXEC. No physical SalesOrder reservation or lot identity is claimed.
semantics.allocation: EXPLANATORY_PLAN_FIFO_NO_RESERVATION. Each accepted plan version is independent. Match supply available by PlanAt to known order-line shipments, BOM demand and modeled forecast shipments. Allocation does not modify MILP or DES.
semantics.balance: Within one decision version and supply row, SupplyQty = AllocatedQty + ResidualQty. Unlimited external supply is materialized only for actual planned demand, not as infinite stock.
semantics.rop: ROP has order/job/material details but no accepted MILP plan; advisory plan tables are empty, not missing data.
semantics.order_material: EXPLANATORY_PLAN_PROPORTIONAL_LINEAGE_NO_RESERVATION. Attribute each BOM issue proportionally to the FIFO output supply used for known order-line shipment. Traverse only production within the accepted plan. Stop at opening stock/WIP or purchased/virtual supply; do not invent their prior genealogy. MaterialDepth separates levels; IsLeafComponent is based on the frozen input BOM. For each component-consumption edge, total attributed to customer orders cannot exceed its original allocated quantity.
